text:
marta-peopleops: FYI — we have an intern conversion for Jonah (ending 7/31) with proposed FT start 8/1. Manager is asking for L3 comp, 8% sign-on, prorated RSUs, and benefits active day one. Asking for quick routing.

devon-mgr: TL;DR — base $130k (above midpoint), sign-on $10,400 (8%), RSU 1200 prorated for year one, start 2026-08-01. Prefer 6-month clawback on sign-on. Candidate is Seattle-based.

rosa-recruit: Candidate verbally accepted pending written offer. Manager wants to lock comp before they shop it.

marta-peopleops: Need manager justification + headcount code to start exception routing. Also flag if candidate has prior sign-on.

devon-mgr: Justification: "owns core infra CI pipeline; immediate owner needed; multiple external inbound messages this month." Headcount: ENG-2026-08-PIPE. No prior sign-on.

recruiting-lead: Routing path: hiring manager -> recruiting lead (that's me) -> finance -> people-ops exceptions committee -> legal (if clawback <12 mo).

finance-ops: Quick check: base $130k + sign-on $10.4k ~ $140.4k first-year cash. That's ~6% above band midpoint. Tagging as hiring premium. Approve to committee if packet includes GL code.

payroll-bot: payroll timeline: to get benefits active 8/1 we need signed offer + HRIS entry by COB Wed. Off-cycle equity proration requires equity-team signoff.

equity-team: We can prorate RSUs to nearest quarter; need final grant amount and start date now. If 1200 RSUs, please confirm desired first-year proration method (pro rata by days or quarter).

marta-peopleops: Manager prefers pro rata by days for first year. Note: exceptions committee prefers quarter-based proration typically. Will note both options in packet.

legal-bot: Legal note: 6-month clawback enforceability in WA is generally okay but include explicit repayment terms and timing. For CA hires, a 6-month clawback can be problematic; recommend 12 months for CA. Also confirm candidate state.

devon-mgr: Candidate is US, Seattle (WA). Manager insists 6 months is sufficient.

marta-peopleops: I'll prepare exception packet with manager justification, headcount code, budget calc, and proposed 6-month clawback language for legal review.

finance-ops: Also include GL tag ENG-2026-08-PIPE in packet so we can finalize budget check. If committee approves, we need finance final sign-off before offer.

recruiting-lead: Candidate asks for benefits day one. We'll try to meet payroll cutoff. Candidate ETA to sign: within 36 hours of offer email.

legal-bot: Draft clawback snippet posted: "Sign-on repayment: If Employee voluntarily resigns or is terminated for cause within six (6) months of the Start Date, Employee agrees to repay the sign-on payment in full within sixty (60) days. Repayment will be due in a single lump sum unless otherwise agreed in writing." Feedback welcome.

marta-peopleops: Please add fallback language: "Company reserves the right to deduct repayment from final wages where permitted by law and with Employee written consent."

legal-bot: Will add consent checkbox in offer template. Also will add CA fallback to 12 months.

finance-ops: Packet looks ok for committee if we formalize cost amortization. Approve to exceptions committee.

marta-peopleops: Exceptions committee scheduled in 3 hours. If approved, legal will finalize language and people-ops will issue offer same day. Payroll deadline is tight — please keep messages short. :timer_clock:

rosa-recruit: Thanks. I'll inform candidate we'll send offer after committee confirmation.

marta-peopleops: Committee approved with one ask: equity proration to follow quarter-based method (company standard) not pro-rata by days. Manager accepts. Legal finalizing clawback and offer template now.

legal-bot: Final redlines done. Clawback set to 6 months for WA hires; 12 months for CA. Repayment terms and consent included.

payroll-bot: Confirming HRIS entry must be complete by Wed COB to ensure benefits active 8/1. Please upload signed offer immediately after candidate signs.

marta-peopleops: Offer to be sent today. Will archive thread after acceptance. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
